# Router codec fixture provenance

`v1.json` is generated by the standalone Rust program `generate.rs`. Expected
bytes use Rust's `u64::to_le_bytes` and `u128::to_le_bytes`; neither generation nor
the checked-in fixtures depend on the TypeScript codec. Normal SDK tests read
the JSON and require neither Rust nor the sibling router repository.

Source: `arch-swap-router` revision
`40dd9c6a5fa2dbbf7dc332dcb3d0500b7a0c8958`.

| Cases | Source |
| --- | --- |
| 24 `idl-*` instruction cases | `tests/idl.rs::idl_decodes_one_two_and_three_hop_wire_fixtures`, preserving all combinations of route shape, direction, and price limit |
| 4 `dispatch-*` instruction cases | Supported cases from `tests/instruction_dispatch.rs::valid_wire_routes_reach_the_expected_execution_guards`; reserved PropAMM is excluded |
| `idl-result` | `tests/idl.rs::idl_matches_program_identity_accounts_errors_and_return_data` |
| Remaining result cases | `tests/route_result.rs`, using the packing layout from `src/result.rs::RouteResultV1::pack` |

Three additional instruction cases cover boundaries accepted by
`src/instruction.rs::RouterInstruction::unpack`: zero deadline, unchanged
millisecond deadline with asymmetric amount bytes, and three CLAMM steps with
full-width amounts/prices and supplemental counts 0, 1, and 2. These are framing
fixtures, not claims that the routes can execute against venue accounts.

This produces **31 instruction fixtures** and **12 result fixtures**. Rust's
result decoder accepts the entire u64 domain, including zero; transaction
success, rollback, and publisher identity are separate receipt checks.

## Regeneration

Run from the SDK root with an installed Rust toolchain. On PowerShell:

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path node_modules/.cache/router-codec | Out-Null
rustc --edition=2021 tests/fixtures/router-codec/generate.rs -o node_modules/.cache/router-codec/generate.exe
& ./node_modules/.cache/router-codec/generate.exe tests/fixtures/router-codec/v1.json
```

The generator writes UTF-8 directly to the given path, avoiding PowerShell output
redirection encoding differences. Its build artifacts stay in ignored
`node_modules/.cache`, outside the packed package. Review fixture changes against
the pinned Rust source; never regenerate expected bytes from the SDK encoder.

The fixture generator reproduces the upstream fixture construction using only
the Rust standard library. It does not execute the upstream parser or IDL tests.
